role_summary: Senior FinOps role leading cloud and infrastructure financial management across GCP, AWS and on-prem environments, with Kuala Lumpur included in the hiring locations.
responsibility_text: Cloud cost optimization across GCP, AWS and on-prem; compute, storage, network and Kubernetes usage analysis; forecasting and cost dashboards; tagging, budgeting and governance; architecture and workload-placement decisions; rightsizing, reservation planning and autoscaling; anomaly detection, usage attribution and FinOps reviews. Partner with Engineering team, Product team and Finance team on architecture, scaling and cost decisions.
requirement_text: GCP and AWS; Kubernetes; GCP billing exports, BigQuery, AWS CUR, Kubecost and CloudHealth; SQL-based pipelines; forecasting models; engineering, product and Finance collaboration.
preferred_text: GCP or AWS professional-level certification; FinOps Certified Practitioner; chargeback/showback; Terraform, Helm or GitOps; data analytics, cloud architecture or financial modelling.
